text_block_list.text:
Senior Classâthe day of our first major 
goal, the Victoria Mile, has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get out there. If you space 
out, this mile race will be over in the 
blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to overthink things during 
a race. Though today, that actually felt 
like a good thing.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I need a next target— to draw out the next 
version of myself.
choice_data_list:
You mean you might be able to see 
something?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, whenever it matters most, I've 
always felt it with my own body.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The answer is always lying somewhere 
inside the race. And that answer is—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When you empty your head and sprint with 
everything you've got, that's when you see 
what's on the other side of the tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"For the first time in a while, I'm 
standing here with a completely clear 
mind. Purely to run fast."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Not bad... Oddly enough, I feel like times 
like this are when you actually find 
something.
choice_data_list: I see, shall we go look for it then?
I see, let's go look for it then.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, in true fashion for me, I'm diving 
in with reckless abandon.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Victoria. I have no intention of casually 
playing the Goddess of Victory. I'm 
desperate here too!
